recipe.name: Onion Pakora
steps: Separate the onion slices and toss with salt, chilli, carom, turmeric and coriander. Rest until the onion releases moisture.
Mix in gram flour and rice flour. Add water only a spoonful at a time until the flour just clings to the onion; this should not be a pourable batter.
Heat oil over medium heat. Drop loose small handfuls of onion mixture into it without compressing them, leaving room around each fritter.
Turn the pakoras as the edges set and fry until deep golden, crisp and cooked through. Keep the oil at a steady medium heat.
Lift out with a slotted spoon, drain well and serve immediately with coriander chutney or hot tea.
tips: Onion moisture should bind the coating; excess water makes heavy, oily pakoras.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Aloo Pakora
steps: Slice peeled potatoes into uniformly thin rounds and pat them dry; thick slices may remain raw in the centre.
Whisk gram flour, rice flour, chilli, carom, turmeric and salt. Add water gradually to make a smooth batter that coats a spoon without running off.
Heat oil to medium hot. Dip each potato slice in batter, let the excess drip off and slide it carefully into the oil in small batches.
Fry, turning once the coating sets, until both sides are golden and the potato inside is tender. Adjust the heat so the crust does not brown before the potato cooks.
Drain on a rack or absorbent paper and serve warm with chutney.
tips: Cut the potato thinly and evenly so the centre cooks before the crust gets too dark.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Palak Pakora
steps: Wash spinach thoroughly, keep the leaves whole, trim thick stems and dry each leaf completely.
Whisk gram flour, rice flour, carom, chilli, turmeric and salt with water into a smooth medium-thick batter.
Heat oil over medium heat. Coat one leaf at a time in a thin layer of batter and gently lower it into the oil, without crowding.
Turn after the batter sets and fry until the leaf-shaped pakoras are crisp and golden on both sides.
Drain on a rack and serve promptly with tamarind or green chutney.
tips: Dry leaves prevent splattering and help the light batter adhere evenly.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Mix Veg Pakora
steps: Chop cauliflower and cabbage very finely so they cook during frying. Squeeze excess moisture from the shredded vegetables.
Toss the vegetables with onion, chilli, coriander, carom and salt. Mix in both flours until all the pieces are lightly coated.
Add a little water only if needed to bind the vegetables into loose clusters; avoid a runny batter.
Drop small spoonfuls into medium-hot oil in batches. Fry while turning until the edges are deeply crisp and the vegetable centres are tender.
Drain well and serve hot with mint chutney.
tips: Small, evenly chopped vegetables cook through before the outside browns.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Dal Vada
steps: Rinse moong dal and soak until swollen but not mushy, then drain thoroughly and leave in a sieve until surface moisture is gone.
Pulse the dal with ginger, chilli and very little water to a coarse paste with some visible lentil bits. Do not puree it smooth.
Mix in coriander, cumin, asafoetida and salt. Beat the mixture briefly to lighten it, then shape rough small mounds with wet hands.
Fry batches in medium-hot oil, turning gently after they firm up, until the vadas are evenly golden and cooked through.
Drain well and serve hot in the Gujarati street style with chutney and, if desired, fried green chillies.
tips: Coarse grinding and complete draining make the vadas crisp rather than dense.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Moong Dal Pakodi
steps: Rinse and soak moong dal until plump, then drain completely. Grind with ginger, chilli and just enough water to make a thick, nearly smooth paste.
Stir in crushed coriander, pepper, coriander leaves, asafoetida and salt. Beat the batter briskly to incorporate air; it should hold a spoonful without spreading.
Heat oil to medium hot. Drop small spoonfuls of batter carefully into the oil, leaving room for the pakodis to expand.
Turn gently and fry until puffed, golden and cooked through. Keep the heat moderate so the centre cooks without a burnt crust.
Drain thoroughly and serve hot with green or tamarind chutney.
tips: Beating a thick moong batter is what gives pakodis their light interior.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Masala Vada
steps: Rinse and soak chana dal until swollen. Drain completely, reserve a small handful of whole dal and coarsely pulse the rest with chillies, fennel and ginger without added water.
Mix reserved whole dal, onion, chopped curry leaves, coriander and salt into the coarse mixture. It should hold together when pressed but still show dal pieces.
Form small balls and flatten each between your palms into a thin disc with rough edges.
Fry in medium-hot oil in batches, turning after the underside is firm, until both faces are golden and the centre is fully cooked.
Drain well and serve warm with coconut chutney or tea.
tips: A coarse grind and a few whole lentils create the distinctive crunchy masala-vada texture.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Butter Murukku
steps: Sift the three flours together. Rub in butter thoroughly, then mix in sesame, asafoetida and salt.
Add water gradually to make a soft, smooth dough that can be pressed without cracking; do not make it sticky.
Fit a murukku press with a small star plate. Press neat loose spirals onto small oiled squares of paper or directly over medium-hot oil.
Slide the spirals into oil and fry gently, turning once, until bubbling subsides and they are pale golden rather than dark brown.
Drain, cool completely so they crisp up, then serve or store airtight.
tips: Too much butter makes the spirals break in the oil; measure it accurately.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Kara Boondi
steps: Whisk gram and rice flours with half the salt and water into a lump-free batter that runs from a spoon in a steady ribbon.
Heat oil to medium hot. Hold a perforated boondi ladle just above it and pour a little batter onto the ladle so round drops fall through. Fry in small batches until crisp.
Wipe and dry the ladle between batches so boondi stays round. Separately fry peanuts until crisp and dry curry leaves briefly until brittle.
Drain everything fully and toss the cool boondi with peanuts, curry leaves, chilli, asafoetida and the remaining salt.
Let the mixture cool completely before serving or storing airtight.
tips: The batter must flow freely but not be watery; wipe the perforated ladle after each batch.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Madras Mixture
steps: Mix 200 g gram flour, 40 g rice flour, 5 g salt and about 120 ml water into a soft pressable dough. Press fine strands into medium-hot oil and fry until crisp to make sev.
Whisk the remaining 120 g gram flour and 30 g rice flour with about 210 ml water into a pourable boondi batter. Pour over a perforated ladle held above hot oil and fry the droplets until crisp.
Fry peanuts and roasted gram separately until crisp, then briefly fry completely dry curry leaves. Drain every component and cool fully.
Break the sev into short lengths. Toss it with boondi, nuts, curry leaves, chilli powder, asafoetida and remaining salt.
Taste and adjust seasoning, then serve or transfer the fully cooled mixture to an airtight container.
tips: Cool each fried component before mixing so the mixture remains crunchy in storage.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Whisk the remaining 120 g gram flour and: बचे 120 ग्राम बेसन और 30 ग्राम चावल के आटे को लगभग 210 मिली पानी से फेंटकर बूंदी का बहने वाला घोल बनाएँ। गरम तेल के ऊपर छेद वाली झारी पर डालें और बूँदें कुरकुरी तलें।
hi.Fry peanuts and roasted gram separately: मूँगफली और भुना चना अलग-अलग कुरकुरे तलें, फिर पूरी तरह सूखे करी पत्ते थोड़ी देर तलें। हर चीज़ निथारकर पूरी तरह ठंडी करें।

hi.Cool each fried component before mixing: हर तली चीज़ मिलाने से पहले ठंडी करें ताकि रखा मिश्रण कुरकुरा रहे।

gu.Break the sev into short lengths. Toss i: સેવને ટૂંકા ટુકડામાં તોડો. બૂંદી, મગફળી, લીમડાનાં પાન, મરચું પાઉડર, હિંગ અને બાકી મીઠું ભેળવો.

recipe.name: Bhakarwadi
steps: Mix both dough flours with half the salt. Rub in the measured oil until sandy, then add water gradually and knead a firm smooth dough. Cover and rest.
Dry-toast coconut, sesame, coriander and fennel separately until fragrant. Cool, grind coarsely, then blend with chilli, jaggery and the remaining salt.
Divide dough and roll thin rectangles. Brush each lightly with tamarind paste, spread the dry filling to the edges, then roll tightly into logs and seal the ends.
Cut the logs into narrow pinwheels and press each slice gently so the swirl stays intact. Fry in medium-low oil, turning often, until fully crisp and golden.
Drain and cool completely before serving; the sweet-spicy centre should stay distinct from the brittle outer pastry.
tips: Fry pinwheels slowly so the rolled centre dries before the outside darkens.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Masala Khakhra
steps: Mix wheat flour, chilli, turmeric, cumin, carom and salt until the masala is evenly distributed.
Add the measured oil and water gradually, then knead a firm, smooth dough. Cover and rest briefly so it rolls without cracking.
Divide into small balls and roll each one extremely thin and evenly round, dusting very lightly with flour only when needed.
Cook on a dry tawa over low heat. Turn repeatedly and press the whole surface with a folded cloth or khakhra press until the bread is uniformly dry, browned in spots and brittle.
Cool each khakhra separately on a rack before stacking; serve plain or store airtight once completely cold.
tips: Press continuously on low heat; merely roasting like a roti leaves the centre soft.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Bajra Khakhra
steps: Mix millet and wheat flours with sesame, carom, turmeric and salt. Use fresh millet flour so the dough does not taste bitter.
Add the measured oil and water gradually, then knead a firm, smooth dough. Cover and rest briefly so it rolls without cracking.
Divide into small balls and roll each one extremely thin and evenly round, dusting very lightly with flour only when needed.
Cook on a dry tawa over low heat. Turn repeatedly and press the whole surface with a folded cloth or khakhra press until the bread is uniformly dry, browned in spots and brittle.
Cool each khakhra separately on a rack before stacking; serve plain or store airtight once completely cold.
tips: Millet dough is more fragile than wheat; roll between sheets if it cracks.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Nylon Sev
steps: Sift gram flour and rice flour together to remove lumps. Mix in turmeric, asafoetida, salt and the measured dough oil.
Add water gradually and knead a soft, perfectly smooth dough that can pass through the finest sev plate without tearing.
Fit the sev press with its tiniest holes and grease it lightly. Heat oil to medium hot and press thin strands directly over the oil in a loose circle.
Fry briefly, turning once, until bubbling nearly stops and the strands are pale golden. Lift out before they darken.
Drain and cool completely; break into short nests for chaat or keep the fine strands in an airtight tin.
tips: The finest press plate and smooth dough make nylon sev distinct from thicker snack sev.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।

hi.Fit the sev press with its tiniest holes: सेव प्रेस में सबसे बारीक जाली लगाकर हल्का तेल लगाएँ। तेल मध्यम गरम करें और सीधे तेल के ऊपर ढीले गोल में बारीक तार दबाएँ।
hi.Fry briefly, turning once, until bubblin: थोड़ी देर तलें, एक बार पलटें और बुलबुले लगभग रुककर तार हल्के सुनहरे हों तो निकालें; गहरे न होने दें।
hi.Drain and cool completely; break into sh: निथारकर पूरी तरह ठंडा करें; चाट के लिए छोटी घोंसली जैसी सेव तोड़ें या बारीक तार बंद डिब्बे में रखें।
hi.The finest press plate and smooth dough: सबसे बारीक जाली और चिकने आटे से नायलॉन सेव मोटी नमकीन सेव से अलग बनती है।

gu.The finest press plate and smooth dough: સૌથી ઝીણી જાળી અને સુંવાળા લોટથી નાયલોન સેવ જાડી નમકીન સેવથી અલગ બને છે.

recipe.name: Aloo Bhujia
steps: Mash boiled potatoes while warm and press through a sieve until completely smooth, with no lumps that could block the sev press.
Mix in gram flour, rice flour, chilli, turmeric, mango powder, asafoetida, salt and measured dough oil to form a soft, non-sticky dough; add no water unless absolutely needed.
Fit a thin sev plate to the press. Press the potato dough in loose circles directly into medium-hot oil, taking care not to overlap thickly.
Turn once and fry until the strands are golden and crisp with no bubbling. Drain thoroughly.
Cool completely, then gently break into short pieces and store airtight or serve as a snack.
tips: Use lump-free potato mash or the fine press holes will clog and the strands will break.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Dal Moth
steps: Soak masoor and moth separately until plump but firm. Drain very thoroughly, spread on towels and allow the surface to dry completely before frying.
Heat oil to medium hot and fry the lentils in small separate batches until crisp, with splatter protection and a dry slotted spoon. Drain each batch.
Fry peanuts separately until golden and let all fried ingredients cool fully. Break nylon sev into short strands.
Mix coriander, chilli, mango powder and both salts. Toss with the cooled lentils, peanuts and sev until evenly coated.
Taste for tartness and serve dry, or store in an airtight jar only after everything is cool.
tips: Never add damp soaked lentils to hot oil; dry them thoroughly first to prevent violent splattering.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।

recipe.name: Fulwadi
steps: Whisk yogurt with sugar, salt, chilli, crushed fennel, coriander and pepper until the sugar dissolves. Stir in sesame.
Rub measured dough oil into coarse gram flour, then add the seasoned yogurt and knead a stiff dough. Rest covered so the flour hydrates.
Pinch off small portions and roll into short, thick, irregular fingers or nuggets. Keep them similar in size for even frying.
Fry on medium-low heat in small batches, turning frequently, until deep golden and crisp to the centre; high heat leaves the middle doughy.
Drain, cool completely and serve as dry farsan or store airtight.
tips: A firm dough and slow frying produce the characteristic dense, crisp fulwadi bite.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Fry on medium-low heat in small batches,: मध्यम-धीमी आँच पर थोड़ी-थोड़ी फुलवड़ी बार-बार पलटते हुए गहरी सुनहरी और बीच तक कुरकुरी तलें; तेज आँच में भीतर कच्ची रहती है।
hi.Drain, cool completely and serve as dry: निथारें, पूरी तरह ठंडा करें और सूखे फरसाण की तरह परोसें या बंद डिब्बे में रखें।
hi.A firm dough and slow frying produce the: कड़ा आटा और धीमी तलायी से फुलवड़ी की खास घनी कुरकुराहट आती है।

recipe.name: Kothimbir Vadi
steps: Wash coriander, dry well and chop finely including tender stems. Grind chilli, ginger and garlic into a coarse paste.
Mix coriander, paste, gram flour, rice flour, turmeric, sesame and salt. Add water gradually to make a thick spreadable batter.
Spread in an oiled shallow tin and steam until a skewer comes out clean and the slab feels firm. Cool completely before cutting into even squares.
Heat a little oil in a wide pan and shallow-fry the squares on both sides until the surfaces are golden and crisp.
Drain briefly and serve warm with green chutney.
tips: Cooling the steamed slab fully is essential for clean squares that do not crumble in the pan.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Makai na Vada
steps: Mix maize flour with chilli, ginger, sesame, cumin, jaggery and salt. Rub in the measured dough oil.
Add yogurt gradually and knead into a firm but pliable dough. Rest covered to let the maize flour hydrate; it should hold together without crumbling.
With lightly oiled hands, form small balls and flatten into palm-sized discs of even thickness. Smooth cracked edges gently.
Fry in medium-hot oil in batches, turning once firm, until both sides are golden and the centre is cooked rather than gummy.
Drain on a rack and serve warm with green chutney or masala tea.
tips: Use fresh maize flour and thick yogurt; a runny dough is difficult to shape and absorbs oil.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Ponk Vada

ingredients.name: fresh tender green sorghum grains, ponk

steps: Pick through fresh ponk to remove husks, rinse briefly and dry well. Crush only part of it coarsely, leaving many tender grains whole.
Mix crushed and whole ponk with chilli, ginger, herbs, cumin and salt. Add gram and rice flours; use a little water only if the mixture will not bind.
Shape small, loose fritters with damp hands; do not pack them tightly or the grains lose their light texture.
Fry in medium-hot oil in batches until golden outside and hot through, turning gently as they set.
Drain thoroughly and serve at once with green chutney while the seasonal ponk remains sweet and tender.
tips: Fresh ponk is seasonal; use tender grains, not dried mature sorghum, for the intended texture.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Kara Sev
steps: Sift the two flours and blend with pepper, chilli, asafoetida and salt. Rub in the measured dough oil.
Add water gradually and knead a soft, smooth, non-sticky dough that can pass through the thick sev die.
Heat oil to medium hot. Press short, thick strands directly into the oil with a broad-hole sev press, working in small batches.
Turn the strands and fry until crisp and evenly golden, with bubbling almost stopped. Do not darken the pepper-spiced sev.
Drain, cool completely and break into snack-sized lengths before serving or storing airtight.
tips: Use a larger press hole than nylon sev; karasev is deliberately thicker and peppery.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Mullu Murukku
steps: Sift rice, urad and roasted gram flours together. Mix in sesame, cumin, asafoetida and salt, then rub in ghee.
Add warm water gradually to form a smooth, pliable dough that can be pressed without cracking. Keep covered while shaping.
Fit the press with a star-shaped ridged plate. Press distinct thorny spirals onto small oiled squares, keeping coils slightly apart.
Slide spirals into medium-hot oil and fry in batches, turning once, until bubbling stops and each ring is evenly crisp and golden.
Drain and cool fully before stacking; serve or store airtight.
tips: The star die gives mullu murukku its thorny ridges; a round die makes a different snack.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Vazhakkai Bajji
steps: Peel raw green bananas and slice lengthwise into evenly thin oval pieces. Hold briefly in water to prevent browning, then dry the slices thoroughly.
Whisk gram flour, rice flour, chilli, turmeric, asafoetida and salt with water into a smooth thick-flowing batter.
Heat oil to medium hot. Dip each dry banana slice in batter and let excess drip off before lowering it into the oil in small batches.
Turn when the first side sets and fry until both sides are golden, the crust is crisp and the raw banana inside is tender.
Drain well and serve hot with coconut or coriander chutney.
tips: Dry banana slices before battering so the coating does not slip off in the oil.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Turn when the first side sets and fry un: पहली ओर परत जमने पर पलटें और दोनों ओर सुनहरी, परत कुरकुरी तथा भीतर कच्चा केला नरम होने तक तलें।
hi.Drain well and serve hot with coconut or: अच्छी तरह निथारकर नारियल या धनिया चटनी के साथ गरम परोसें।

gu.Drain well and serve hot with coconut or: સારી રીતે નિતારી નાળિયેર અથવા ધાણાની ચટણી સાથે ગરમ પીરસો.
gu.Dry banana slices before battering so th: ખીરું લગાવતાં પહેલાં કેળાની ચીરીઓ સૂકવો જેથી પડ તેલમાં ઊતરી ન જાય.

recipe.name: Doddapatre Bajji
steps: Wash and dry the borage leaves thoroughly. Keep each leaf whole and trim only the toughest stem.
Whisk gram flour, rice flour, chilli, carom, turmeric and salt. Gradually add water to make a smooth batter that coats a leaf without running off.
Heat oil over medium heat. Dip one leaf at a time, coat both sides thinly and lower carefully into the oil.
Fry in small batches, turning once, until the leaf-shaped fritters are golden and crisp; drain on a rack.
Serve immediately with coconut chutney while the leaf centres are tender and the batter stays crisp.
tips: Dry leaves prevent the batter from sliding off; do not pile the fried bajji while hot.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Fry in small batches, turning once, unti: थोड़े-थोड़े पत्ते तलें, बीच में एक बार पलटें; सुनहरे और कुरकुरे होने पर जाली पर निकालें।
hi.Serve immediately with coconut chutney w: पत्तों के बीच का भाग नरम और बाहर का घोल कुरकुरा रहते नारियल की चटनी के साथ तुरंत परोसें।
hi.Dry leaves prevent the batter from slidi: सूखे पत्तों पर घोल अच्छी तरह टिकता है; गरम बज्जी को एक-दूसरे पर न रखें।

gu.Dry leaves prevent the batter from slidi: સૂકા પાન પર ખીરું સારી રીતે ચોંટે છે; ગરમ ભજીને એકબીજા પર ઢગલો ન કરો.

recipe.name: Ulli Vada
steps: Separate the onion slices with your fingers. Toss with salt and leave briefly so the onions release a little moisture.
Mix in ginger, green chillies, curry leaves, chilli powder, gram flour and rice flour. Rub the flours through the onions rather than making a thick smooth batter.
Sprinkle in just enough water for the onion strands to cling loosely together. Heat oil over medium heat.
Drop loose small handfuls into the oil without squeezing them into dense balls. Fry in batches until deep golden, turning for even colour.
Drain on a rack and serve hot with coconut chutney; the rice flour should make the onion edges distinctly crisp.
tips: If the mixture becomes wet, dust with a little more rice flour instead of packing the fritters tightly.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Sprinkle in just enough water for the on: प्याज के लच्छे बस हल्के जुड़ें इतना ही पानी छिड़कें। तेल मध्यम आँच पर गरम करें।
hi.Drop loose small handfuls into the oil w: मुट्ठीभर मिश्रण बिना दबाकर तेल में छोड़ें। थोड़ा-थोड़ा तलें और पलटते हुए गहरा सुनहरा करें।
hi.Drain on a rack and serve hot with cocon: जाली पर निकालकर नारियल चटनी के साथ गरम परोसें; चावल के आटे से प्याज के किनारे कुरकुरे होने चाहिए।
hi.If the mixture becomes wet, dust with a: मिश्रण गीला हो जाए तो वड़ों को दबाने के बजाय थोड़ा और चावल का आटा लगाएँ।

gu.Sprinkle in just enough water for the on: ડુંગળીના તાર ઢીલા જોડાઈ રહે એટલું જ પાણી છાંટો. તેલ મધ્યમ તાપે ગરમ કરો.
gu.Drop loose small handfuls into the oil w: નાની મુઠ્ઠી મિશ્રણ દબાવ્યા વગર તેલમાં છોડો. થોડું થોડું તળો અને ફેરવતાં ઘેરું સોનેરી કરો.
gu.Drain on a rack and serve hot with cocon: જાળી પર કાઢી નાળિયેરની ચટણી સાથે ગરમ પીરસો; ચોખાના લોટથી ડુંગળીની કિનારીઓ કરકરી થવી જોઈએ.
gu.If the mixture becomes wet, dust with a: મિશ્રણ ભીનું થઈ જાય તો વડા દબાવવાને બદલે થોડો વધુ ચોખાનો લોટ છાંટો.

recipe.name: Kuzhalappam
steps: Grind coconut, shallots, garlic and cumin with part of the measured water; strain to obtain a strongly flavoured liquid.
Bring that liquid and remaining water to a simmer with salt. Turn off heat and stir in rice flour and sesame to make a soft, non-sticky dough.
Cover until warm, then knead smooth. Roll small portions between oiled sheets into thin circles.
Wrap each disc around an oiled narrow handle or tube and seal the overlap with water; slide off gently, keeping the hollow centre open.
Fry the tubes in medium-hot coconut oil until lightly golden and crisp throughout. Drain, cool completely and store airtight.
tips: A stiff or dry dough cracks while rolling; knead in a few drops of warm water if needed.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।
hi.Grind coconut, shallots, garlic and cumi: नारियल, छोटे प्याज, लहसुन और जीरा दिए पानी के कुछ भाग के साथ पीसें; छानकर सुगंधित रस लें।
hi.Bring that liquid and remaining water to: उस रस और बचे पानी में नमक डालकर गरम करें। आँच बंद कर चावल का आटा और तिल मिलाएँ; नरम, न चिपकने वाला आटा बनाएँ।
hi.Cover until warm, then knead smooth. Rol: ढककर गुनगुना होने दें, फिर चिकना गूँधें। छोटे भाग तेल लगी चादरों के बीच पतले गोल बेलें।
hi.Wrap each disc around an oiled narrow ha: हर गोल को तेल लगे पतले बेलन या नली पर लपेटें, जोड़ पानी से चिपकाएँ; बीच खोखला रखते हुए धीरे निकालें।
hi.Fry the tubes in medium-hot coconut oil: नलियों को मध्यम गरम नारियल तेल में हल्का सुनहरा और पूरी तरह कुरकुरा तलें। निकालकर पूरा ठंडा करें और बंद डिब्बे में रखें।
hi.A stiff or dry dough cracks while rollin: कड़ा या सूखा आटा बेलते समय फटता है; ज़रूरत हो तो गर्म पानी की कुछ बूँदें मिलाएँ।

recipe.name: Corn Pakoda
steps: Roughly crush a third of the corn kernels and leave the rest whole. Pat the kernels dry to keep the pakoda crisp.
Combine corn, onion, chillies, ginger, coriander, chilli powder and salt. Mix in gram flour and rice flour until every kernel is coated.
Sprinkle only enough water to bind small rough clusters; do not make a pourable batter. Heat oil over medium heat.
Drop small spoonfuls into the oil. Fry without crowding, turning until the corn is cooked and the exterior is evenly golden.
Drain on a rack, dust lightly with chaat masala if desired and serve at once with green chutney.
tips: A little crushed corn acts as a binder while whole kernels give each pakoda its signature bite.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Echorer Chop
steps: Oil your hands and knife before handling jackfruit. Steam the jackfruit until tender, boil potatoes separately and drain both thoroughly.
Shred the jackfruit and mash the potatoes. Cook onion, ginger and chilli in a little oil until aromatic, then add jackfruit, cumin, garam masala and salt.
Cook the filling until dry; fold in potato and cool completely. Shape into firm oval chops.
Whisk cornflour with water into a thin slurry. Dip each chop and coat all sides evenly with breadcrumbs; chill until the coating sets.
Fry in medium-hot oil in small batches until crisp and deep golden. Drain well and serve with Bengali mustard relish.
tips: The filling must be dry and cool before shaping or the croquettes will split in oil.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Posto Bora
steps: Soak poppy seeds until softened, drain and grind with green chillies and a little measured water to a coarse thick paste.
Fold in onion, rice flour, nigella and salt. The mixture should hold its shape on a spoon; add only a few drops of remaining water if needed.
Heat a thin layer of mustard oil until its raw aroma fades, then lower to medium heat.
Drop small spoonfuls into the pan and flatten gently into little discs. Fry both sides until brown and firm, adding oil around the edges.
Drain briefly and serve hot beside rice and dal or as a tea-time snack.
tips: Do not grind the seeds completely smooth: a little texture makes the crisp crust characteristic.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Kurdai
steps: Wash wheat and soak overnight in part of the measured water. Drain, grind finely with fresh measured water and strain through muslin to collect the starch-rich milk.
Leave the wheat milk undisturbed so starch settles. Pour off the clear liquid carefully; repeat rinsing and settling until the starch is pale and clean.
Mix the settled starch with remaining water, salt and cumin. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until glossy, thick and translucent.
While warm, press the paste through a sev press into small coiled nests on a clean oiled sheet. Sun-dry completely for two days, turning once; keep covered from dust.
Store the brittle dried kurdai airtight. To serve, fry a few at a time in hot oil until they puff and turn crisp; drain immediately.
tips: Any residual moisture causes stored kurdai to spoil, so finish sun-drying before sealing.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Chana Dal Namkeen
steps: Rinse chana dal and soak until the grains swell but remain separate. Drain completely and spread on a clean towel until surface-dry.
Mix the powdered salt, chilli, black salt, mango powder and asafoetida in a dry bowl; keep ready beside the stove.
Heat oil over medium heat. Add a small batch of dry lentils carefully; fry while stirring until bubbling subsides and the dal is crisp throughout.
Lift with a mesh skimmer, drain well and toss the warm dal immediately with spice mix. Repeat for remaining batches.
Cool fully before sealing in an airtight jar; serve in small bowls as a crunchy dry snack.
tips: Surface-dry lentils prevent dangerous splattering and give a crisp, separate-grain finish.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Masala Kaju
steps: Pat the cashews dry and separate any broken pieces so they roast evenly. Mix chilli, chaat masala, turmeric and salt in a small bowl.
Warm ghee in a heavy pan over low heat. Add curry leaves and cook until dry and crisp.
Add cashews and stir constantly over low heat until golden on all sides; take care not to scorch the pointed tips.
Turn off heat, immediately sprinkle the mixed spices over the warm nuts and toss until every cashew has a thin even coating.
Spread in one layer to cool and crisp up, then serve or pack airtight.
tips: Spices added after the heat is switched off keep their colour and do not turn bitter.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Paneer Manchurian
steps: Pat paneer dry. Mix most cornflour with all-purpose flour, a pinch of salt and enough measured water to make a thin coating; reserve remaining cornflour for the sauce.
Coat paneer cubes lightly and shallow-fry in hot oil until golden at the edges. Drain without overcooking the soft centres.
In a hot wok with a little oil, stir-fry garlic and ginger briefly, then add onion and capsicum; keep the vegetables slightly crisp.
Add soy sauce, ketchup and chilli sauce. Stir remaining cornflour with a splash of water, pour in and bubble until the glossy sauce just coats a spoon.
Toss the fried paneer through the sauce only until coated. Finish with spring onion greens and serve immediately as a dry starter.
tips: Use a sauce with no animal-derived additives; the paneer should stay crisp-edged rather than sitting in gravy.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

gu.Pat paneer dry. Mix most cornflour with: પનીર સુકવો. મોટા ભાગના કોર્નફ્લોરમાં મેંદો, થોડું મીઠું અને આપેલું પાણી ભેળવી પાતળું પડ બનાવો; બાકીનું કોર્નફ્લોર સોસ માટે રાખો.
gu.Coat paneer cubes lightly and shallow-fr: પનીરને હળવું ઢાંકી ગરમ તેલમાં કિનારીઓ સોનેરી થાય ત્યાં સુધી તળો. નરમ મધ્ય ભાગ વધુ રાંધ્યા વગર કાઢો.
gu.In a hot wok with a little oil, stir-fry: ગરમ કડાઈમાં થોડા તેલમાં લસણ અને આદુ ઝટપટ સાંતળો, પછી ડુંગળી અને સિમલા મરચાં નાખો; શાક થોડું કરકરું રાખો.
સોયા સોસ, ટામેટાંની સોસ અને મરચાંની સોસ ઉમેરો. બાકીનું કોર્નફ્લોર થોડા પાણીમાં ઓગાળી નાખો અને ચમકતી સોસ ચમચી પર ચડે ત્યાં સુધી ઉકાળો.
gu.Toss the fried paneer through the sauce: તળેલું પનીર સોસમાં માત્ર પડ ચડે ત્યાં સુધી ભેળવો. લીલી ડુંગળીના પાન નાખી સુકા સ્ટાર્ટર તરીકે તરત પીરસો.
gu.Use a sauce with no animal-derived addit: પ્રાણીજન્ય ઉમેરા વગરની સોસ લો; પનીર ગ્રેવીમાં ડૂબવાને બદલે કિનારીઓએ કરકરું રહે.

recipe.name: Methi Dhebra
steps: Wash fenugreek, dry it and chop finely; discard coarse stems. Dissolve jaggery in yogurt.
Combine both flours, fenugreek, sesame, chilli-ginger paste, turmeric and salt. Add sweetened yogurt and just enough water to make a firm pliable dough.
Rest the dough covered briefly. Divide into small balls and roll each between sheets into a moderately thick round.
Cook on a medium-hot tawa, turning and brushing lightly with oil until both sides have brown spots and the middle is cooked.
Stack under a cloth to stay soft. Serve warm with yogurt, pickle or a little butter.
tips: Roll between sheets because millet flour cracks easily; thick dhebra stay soft rather than drying out.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Wash fenugreek, dry it and chop finely;: मेथी धोकर सुखाएँ और बारीक काटें; मोटे डंठल हटाएँ। गुड़ दही में घोलें।
hi.Combine both flours, fenugreek, sesame,: दोनों आटे, मेथी, तिल, मिर्च-अदरक पेस्ट, हल्दी और नमक मिलाएँ। गुड़ वाला दही और बस ज़रूरी पानी डालकर सख्त लचीला आटा गूँधें।
hi.Rest the dough covered briefly. Divide i: आटा कुछ देर ढककर रखें। छोटे गोले बनाकर चादरों के बीच मध्यम मोटाई के गोल बेलें।
hi.Cook on a medium-hot tawa, turning and b: मध्यम गरम तवे पर पलटते और हल्का तेल लगाते हुए दोनों तरफ भूरे धब्बे और बीच तक पकने तक सेंकें।
hi.Stack under a cloth to stay soft. Serve: नरम रखने के लिए कपड़े में ढककर रखें। दही, अचार या थोड़ा मक्खन साथ गरम परोसें।
hi.Roll between sheets because millet flour: बाजरे का आटा जल्दी फटता है इसलिए चादरों के बीच बेलें; थोड़ा मोटा ढेबरा नरम रहता है।

gu.Rest the dough covered briefly. Divide i: લોટ થોડી વાર ઢાંકીને રાખો. નાના લુવા બનાવી ચાદરો વચ્ચે મધ્યમ જાડાઈના ગોળ વણો.
gu.Cook on a medium-hot tawa, turning and b: મધ્યમ ગરમ તવા પર ફેરવતાં અને થોડું તેલ લગાવતાં બંને બાજુ ભૂરા ટપકા પડે અને મધ્ય સુધી શેકાય ત્યાં સુધી શેકો.
gu.Stack under a cloth to stay soft. Serve: નરમ રહે માટે કપડાથી ઢાંકી રાખો. દહીં, અથાણું કે થોડું માખણ સાથે ગરમ પીરસો.
gu.Roll between sheets because millet flour: બાજરીનો લોટ સહેલાઈથી તૂટે છે એટલે ચાદરો વચ્ચે વણો; થોડું જાડું ઢેબરું નરમ રહે છે.

recipe.name: Beguni
steps: Slice eggplant lengthwise into thin even sheets. Sprinkle with part of the salt and sugar, leave briefly, then pat very dry.
Whisk gram flour, rice flour, turmeric, chilli and remaining salt with water into a smooth batter that coats the back of a spoon.
Heat mustard oil until its raw aroma fades, then keep it moderately hot. Dip each dry slice and shake off excess batter.
Fry a few slices at a time, turning once, until the coating is crisp and the eggplant tender. Drain on a rack.
Dust with black salt and serve immediately alongside tea or khichuri.
tips: Drying the slices before coating is the key to a thin crisp beguni rather than a soggy one.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Heat mustard oil until its raw aroma fad: सरसों तेल की कच्ची गंध दूर होने तक गरम करें, फिर मध्यम गरम रखें। हर सूखा टुकड़ा घोल में डुबोकर अतिरिक्त घोल झाड़ें।
hi.Fry a few slices at a time, turning once: थोड़े-थोड़े टुकड़े एक बार पलटकर परत कुरकुरी और बैंगन नरम होने तक तलें। जाली पर निकालें।
hi.Dust with black salt and serve immediate: काला नमक छिड़ककर चाय या खिचुड़ी के साथ तुरंत परोसें।
hi.Drying the slices before coating is the: घोल लगाने से पहले टुकड़े सुखाना पतली कुरकुरी बेगुनी के लिए ज़रूरी है।

gu.Drying the slices before coating is the: ખીરું લગાડતાં પહેલાં કટકા સુકવવા પાતળી કરકરી બેગુની માટે જરૂરી છે.

recipe.name: Aloo Chop
steps: Boil potatoes until just tender, drain thoroughly and mash while warm; let steam escape so the filling becomes dry.
Mix potato with ginger, chopped chillies, cumin, a little turmeric and salt. Shape into small flattened discs and chill until firm.
Whisk gram flour, rice flour, remaining turmeric and water into a smooth medium-thick batter.
Heat mustard oil until the raw smell fades. Dip each potato disc to coat fully and fry in batches, turning until golden and crisp.
Drain well and serve hot with kasundi mustard and puffed rice if desired.
tips: Keep the potato patties flat, not round like a bonda; that is the familiar Bengali telebhaja shape.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Phuluri
steps: Sift gram flour and rice flour into a bowl with turmeric and salt; stir in nigella and finely minced chilli.
Add water gradually and beat vigorously until the batter is smooth, airy and thick enough to mound on a spoon.
Rest the batter briefly while heating oil over medium heat. Beat it once more just before frying.
Drop small rounded spoonfuls into oil without overcrowding. Turn until puffed, cooked through and golden all around.
Drain on a rack and serve hot with kasundi or a tangy chutney.
tips: Beating the batter adds air; dense batter produces heavy fritters instead of light phuluri.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Sift gram flour and rice flour into a bo: बेसन और चावल का आटा हल्दी और नमक के साथ छानें; कलौंजी और बारीक मिर्च मिलाएँ।
hi.Add water gradually and beat vigorously: धीरे-धीरे पानी डालकर तेज़ फेंटें जब तक घोल चिकना, हवादार और चम्मच पर ढेर-सा टिकने वाला हो।

hi.Drop small rounded spoonfuls into oil wi: छोटे गोल चम्मचभर घोल तेल में डालें, भीड़ न करें। फूले, अंदर तक पके और चारों ओर सुनहरे हों तब तक पलटें।
hi.Drain on a rack and serve hot with kasun: जाली पर निकालकर कसुंदी या खट्टी चटनी के साथ गरम परोसें।
hi.Beating the batter adds air; dense batte: घोल फेंटने से हवा भरती है; बिना फेंटा घोल हल्की फुलुरी के बजाय भारी पकोड़े बनाता है।

gu.Add water gradually and beat vigorously: ધીમે ધીમે પાણી ઉમેરી જોરથી ફેંટો જ્યાં સુધી ખીરું લીસું, હવાદાર અને ચમચી પર ઢગલો થાય એવું ઘટ્ટ બને.
gu.Rest the batter briefly while heating oi: તેલ મધ્યમ તાપે ગરમ થાય ત્યાં સુધી ખીરું થોડી વાર રાખો. તળતાં પહેલાં ફરી ફેંટો.

gu.Drain on a rack and serve hot with kasun: જાળી પર કાઢી કાસુંદી કે ખાટી ચટણી સાથે ગરમ પીરસો.
gu.Beating the batter adds air; dense batte: ખીરું ફેંટવાથી હવા ભળે છે; ન ફેંટેલું ખીરું હલકી ફુલુરીને બદલે ભારે પકોડા બનાવે છે.

recipe.name: Piaji
steps: Wash and soak chana dal until plump. Drain completely; keep a small handful whole and grind the rest coarsely without extra water.
Mix the dal paste with whole dal, onion, minced chillies, ginger, coriander, cumin and salt. Squeeze gently so the onion moisture binds the mixture.
Heat oil over medium heat. Press portions between damp palms into small flat patties with ragged edges.
Slide patties into oil in small batches. Fry slowly, turning, until both sides are deep golden and the lentil centre is fully cooked.
Drain well and serve while crisp, traditionally with puffed rice and tea.
tips: Coarse dal and flattened shape distinguish piaji from soft round lentil fritters.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Wash and soak chana dal until plump. Dra: चना दाल धोकर फूलने तक भिगोएँ। पूरा पानी निकालें; थोड़ी दाल साबुत रखें और बाकी बिना पानी दरदरी पीसें।

वड़े थोड़े-थोड़े तेल में डालें। पलटते हुए धीरे तलें जब तक दोनों तरफ गहरा सुनहरा और बीच की दाल पूरी पकी न हो।
hi.Drain well and serve while crisp, tradit: अच्छी तरह तेल छानें और कुरकुरे रहते परोसें; पारंपरिक रूप से मुरमुरे और चाय के साथ।
hi.Coarse dal and flattened shape distingui: दरदरी दाल और चपटा आकार पियाजी को नरम गोल दाल-पकोड़ों से अलग करते हैं।

recipe.name: Pazham Pori
steps: Peel ripe but firm plantains and cut lengthwise into long even slices; avoid slices so thin that they break.
Whisk flour, rice flour, sugar, turmeric, cardamom and salt. Gradually add water for a smooth batter that clings in a thin layer.
Heat coconut oil over medium heat. Dip each plantain slice, let excess batter drip away and lower gently into the oil.
Fry in small batches, turning until each fritter is golden outside and the fruit within is soft and sweet.
Drain on a rack and serve warm with Kerala tea.
tips: Use ripe plantain rather than raw cooking banana; ripeness gives the signature sweet soft centre.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Parippu Vada
steps: Rinse and soak chana dal until swollen. Drain extremely well; reserve a small handful of whole soaked dal.
Pulse the rest coarsely with dried chilli, ginger and fennel; stop before it becomes a smooth paste.
Fold in whole dal, shallots, finely chopped curry leaves and salt. Press small portions into fairly thin discs.
Heat coconut oil over medium heat. Fry a few patties at a time, turning until deep gold and crisp all the way through.
Drain on a rack and serve immediately with coconut chutney and tea.
tips: Coarse dal and a flat patty give parippu vada its crunchy texture; a wet smooth paste will not.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Mysore Bonda
steps: Whisk yogurt smooth. Stir in both flours, coconut, chilli, ginger, cumin and salt to make a thick batter.
Add just enough water to let the batter fall slowly from a spoon. Beat well to incorporate air; rest briefly.
Fold in baking soda just before frying. Heat oil to medium; a small drop of batter should rise steadily, not darken at once.
Drop rounded spoonfuls into oil, leaving space for them to puff. Turn gently and fry until evenly golden and cooked in the centre.
Drain and serve hot with coconut chutney; the inside should be light and spongy.
tips: This instant bonda uses soda for lift; unlike goli baje, the batter does not need long fermentation.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।
hi.Whisk yogurt smooth. Stir in both flours: दही चिकना फेंटें। दोनों आटे, नारियल, मिर्च, अदरक, जीरा और नमक डालकर गाढ़ा घोल बनाएँ।
hi.Add just enough water to let the batter: बस इतना पानी डालें कि घोल चम्मच से धीरे गिरे। हवा भरने के लिए अच्छी तरह फेंटें; थोड़ी देर रखें।
तलने से ठीक पहले खाने का सोडा मिलाएँ। तेल मध्यम गरम करें; घोल की छोटी बूँद धीरे ऊपर आए, तुरंत काली न हो।
hi.Drop rounded spoonfuls into oil, leaving: गोल चम्मचभर घोल तेल में डालें और फूलने की जगह छोड़ें। हल्के पलटकर बराबर सुनहरे और बीच तक पके तलें।
hi.Drain and serve hot with coconut chutney: तेल छानकर नारियल चटनी के साथ गरम परोसें; भीतर हल्का और स्पंजी होना चाहिए।
hi.This instant bonda uses soda for lift; u: यह तुरंत बनने वाला बोंडा फूलने के लिए सोडा लेता है; गोली बाजे की तरह लंबे खमीर की ज़रूरत नहीं।

gu.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: માત્રા ચાર પુખ્ત વ્યક્તિઓ માટે છે. દરેક પગલામાં પાકવાના સંકેત તપાસો અને સ્વાદ પ્રમાણે મસાલો ગોઠવો. જૈન યોગ્યતા તમારા પરિવારના સામગ્રીના નિયમો પર આધારિત છે.
gu.Whisk yogurt smooth. Stir in both flours: દહીં લીસું ફેંટો. બંને લોટ, નાળિયેર, મરચાં, આદુ, જીરું અને મીઠું ઉમેરી ઘટ્ટ ખીરું બનાવો.
gu.Add just enough water to let the batter: ખીરું ચમચીમાંથી ધીમે પડે એટલું જ પાણી ઉમેરો. હવા ભળે માટે સારી રીતે ફેંટો; થોડી વાર રાખો.
તળતાં પહેલાં ખાવાનો સોડા ભેળવો. તેલ મધ્યમ ગરમ કરો; ખીરાનું નાનું ટીપું ધીમે ઉપર આવે, તરત કાળું ન થાય.
gu.Drop rounded spoonfuls into oil, leaving: ગોળ ચમચીભર ખીરું તેલમાં નાખો અને ફૂલવાની જગ્યા છોડો. હળવે ફેરવી સરખા સોનેરી અને મધ્ય સુધી રંધાય ત્યાં સુધી તળો.
gu.Drain and serve hot with coconut chutney: તેલ નિતારી નાળિયેરની ચટણી સાથે ગરમ પીરસો; અંદર હળવું અને પોચું હોવું જોઈએ.
gu.This instant bonda uses soda for lift; u: આ તરત બનતું બોંડા ફૂલવા સોડા વાપરે છે; ગોલી બાજેની જેમ લાંબા આથાની જરૂર નથી.

recipe.name: Goli Baje
steps: Whisk yogurt with a little measured water. Mix in both flours and salt, beating into a thick smooth batter.
Cover and rest the batter in a warm spot until lightly tangy and bubbly; this coastal version relies on this rest for its soft interior.
Fold in coconut, chilli, ginger and curry leaves without knocking all the air out. Add only enough remaining water if the batter is too stiff.
Heat oil over medium heat. Drop small rounded portions and fry slowly, turning as they puff into irregular golden balls.
Drain and serve fresh with coconut chutney; the crust is lightly crisp and the middle fluffy.
tips: A thick, rested batter gives goli baje its characteristic tang and airy texture.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Drain and serve fresh with coconut chutn: तेल छानकर नारियल चटनी के साथ ताज़ा परोसें; बाहर हल्का कुरकुरा और भीतर फूला नरम हो।
hi.A thick, rested batter gives goli baje i: गाढ़ा विश्राम किया घोल गोली बाजे को खास खट्टापन और हल्की बनावट देता है।

gu.Drain and serve fresh with coconut chutn: તેલ નિતારી નાળિયેરની ચટણી સાથે તાજું પીરસો; બહાર હળવું કરકરું અને અંદર ફૂલેલું નરમ હોય.
gu.A thick, rested batter gives goli baje i: ઘટ્ટ આથેલું ખીરું ગોલી બાજેને ખાસ ખટાશ અને હલકી બનાવટ આપે છે.

recipe.name: Maddur Vada
steps: Mix semolina, rice flour, all-purpose flour, onion, minced chilli, curry leaves, cumin and salt. Rub together to draw moisture from onion.
Add water gradually and bring together into a stiff, rough dough; do not knead it smooth like roti dough.
Divide into small balls and flatten thinly between oiled sheets, leaving ragged onion-studded edges.
Fry in moderately hot oil, turning until both sides are richly golden and the centre has no raw flour taste.
Drain on a rack and serve warm with coconut chutney or tea.
tips: Flatten the discs thinly; thick patties remain soft rather than developing Maddur vada’s signature snap.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Add water gradually and bring together i: पानी धीरे-धीरे डालकर सख्त खुरदरा आटा जोड़ें; रोटी के आटे जैसा चिकना न गूँधें।
hi.Divide into small balls and flatten thin: छोटे गोले तेल लगी चादरों के बीच पतले दबाएँ, प्याज वाले खुरदरे किनारे रहने दें।
hi.Fry in moderately hot oil, turning until: मध्यम गरम तेल में पलटकर दोनों ओर गहरे सुनहरे और बीच का कच्चा आटा पकने तक तलें।
hi.Drain on a rack and serve warm with coco: जाली पर निकालकर नारियल चटनी या चाय के साथ गरम परोसें।
hi.Flatten the discs thinly; thick patties: वड़े पतले दबाएँ; मोटे वड़े मद्दूर की खास कुरकुराहट के बजाय नरम रहेंगे।

gu.Add water gradually and bring together i: પાણી ધીમે ધીમે ઉમેરી કઠણ ખરબચડો લોટ ભેગો કરો; રોટલીના લોટ જેવો લીસો ન મસળો.
gu.Divide into small balls and flatten thin: નાના લુવા તેલ લગાડેલી ચાદરો વચ્ચે પાતળા દબાવો, ડુંગળીવાળી ખરબચડી કિનારીઓ રહેવા દો.

recipe.name: Kuzhi Paniyaram
steps: Rinse rice and urad separately. Soak rice in part of the water, and urad with fenugreek in another portion, until soft.
Grind urad fluffy and rice slightly grainy with only enough measured water. Mix, cover and ferment in a warm place until airy and gently risen.
Heat a little oil; crackle mustard seeds and cook onion, chilli and curry leaves until onion softens. Cool slightly and fold into the batter with salt.
Oil the hollows of a paniyaram pan and fill each mostly full. Cover and cook on medium-low heat until bottoms are golden.
Turn each ball and cook the other side until crisp outside and fluffy inside. Serve hot with coconut chutney.
tips: The batter needs real fermentation for light centres; a heavy unfermented batter makes dense paniyaram.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

gu.Heat a little oil; crackle mustard seeds: થોડા તેલમાં રાઈ તડકાવો અને ડુંગળી, મરચાં, મીઠા લીમડાનાં પાન ડુંગળી નરમ થાય ત્યાં સુધી રાંધો. થોડું ઠંડું કરી મીઠા સાથે ખીરામાં ભેળવો.
gu.Oil the hollows of a paniyaram pan and f: પનિયારમ તવાના ખાડાંમાં તેલ લગાવી લગભગ ભરો. ઢાંકી મધ્યમ-ધીમા તાપે તળિયું સોનેરી થાય ત્યાં સુધી રાંધો.

recipe.name: Konkani Phodi
steps: Peel raw bananas and slice lengthwise into medium-thin ovals. Keep slices in water briefly, then drain and pat completely dry.
Mix tamarind with water, chilli, turmeric and salt. Rub this thin spice coating over all banana slices; rest until absorbed.
Mix rice flour and semolina on a plate. Coat both sides of every slice and shake off loose flour.
Heat a thin layer of coconut oil in a skillet. Lay slices in one layer and shallow-fry over medium heat until the undersides are reddish golden.
Turn and cook the other side until banana is tender and coating crisp. Drain and serve with dal-rice.
tips: Do not crowd the skillet; trapped steam softens the rice-flour and semolina crust.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।
hi.Peel raw bananas and slice lengthwise in: कच्चे केले छीलकर लंबाई में मध्यम पतले अंडाकार टुकड़े काटें। थोड़ी देर पानी में रखें, फिर छानकर पूरी तरह सुखाएँ।
hi.Mix tamarind with water, chilli, turmeri: इमली को पानी, मिर्च, हल्दी और नमक से मिलाएँ। यह पतला मसाला केले के टुकड़ों पर मलें; सोखने तक रखें।
थाली में चावल का आटा और सूजी मिलाएँ। हर टुकड़े के दोनों ओर लपेटें और ढीला आटा झाड़ें।
hi.Heat a thin layer of coconut oil in a sk: तवे में नारियल तेल की पतली परत गरम करें। टुकड़े एक परत में रखकर मध्यम आँच पर नीचे लाल-सुनहरा होने तक सेंकें।
hi.Turn and cook the other side until banan: पलटकर दूसरी ओर केला नरम और परत कुरकुरी होने तक पकाएँ। तेल छानकर दाल-चावल के साथ परोसें।
hi.Do not crowd the skillet; trapped steam: तवे पर भीड़ न करें; फँसी भाप चावल-सूजी की परत नरम कर देती है।

gu.Mix tamarind with water, chilli, turmeri: આંબલીને પાણી, મરચું, હળદર અને મીઠા સાથે ભેળવો. આ પાતળો મસાલો કેળાના કટકાઓ પર ચોળો; શોષાય ત્યાં સુધી રાખો.
થાળીમાં ચોખાનો લોટ અને રવો ભેળવો. દરેક કટકાની બંને બાજુ ઢાંકો અને છૂટો લોટ ઝાડો.
gu.Heat a thin layer of coconut oil in a sk: તવામાં નાળિયેરના તેલનો પાતળો પડ ગરમ કરો. કટકા એક પડમાં રાખી મધ્યમ તાપે તળિયું લાલસોનેરી થાય ત્યાં સુધી શેકો.
gu.Turn and cook the other side until banan: ફેરવી બીજી બાજુ કેળું નરમ અને પડ કરકરું થાય ત્યાં સુધી રાંધો. તેલ નિતારી દાળ-ભાત સાથે પીરસો.

recipe.name: Chura Bhuja
steps: Pick through flattened rice to remove husks. If the flakes feel damp, spread them until dry; do not soak or rinse.
Heat mustard oil in a wide pan and fry peanuts over medium-low heat until browned and crisp; lift out.
In the same oil crisp the chopped chillies and curry leaves. Add turmeric and chilli powder briefly without burning them.
Add dry chura in batches and toss continuously over low heat until every flake turns crisp and lightly golden.
Return peanuts, season with salt and toss well. Cool fully before storing, or serve warm with tea.
tips: Use thick dry flattened rice; thin flakes break and damp flakes become chewy.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.In the same oil crisp the chopped chilli: उसी तेल में कटी मिर्च और करी पत्ते कुरकुरे करें। हल्दी और मिर्च पाउडर डालकर बिना जलाए जल्दी मिलाएँ।
hi.Add dry chura in batches and toss contin: सूखा चूड़ा थोड़ा-थोड़ा डालें और धीमी आँच पर लगातार चलाकर हर दाना कुरकुरा और हल्का सुनहरा करें।
hi.Return peanuts, season with salt and tos: मूँगफली वापस डालें, नमक मिलाकर अच्छी तरह चलाएँ। रखने से पहले पूरा ठंडा करें या चाय के साथ गरम परोसें।
hi.Use thick dry flattened rice; thin flake: मोटा सूखा चूड़ा लें; पतले दाने टूटते और नम दाने चबाने जैसे रह जाते हैं।

gu.Heat mustard oil in a wide pan and fry p: પહોળી કડાઈમાં સરસવનું તેલ ગરમ કરી મગફળી મધ્યમ-ધીમા તાપે ભૂરા કરકરા શેકો; કાઢી લો.

recipe.name: Bhadang
steps: Warm puffed rice in a dry wide pan over low heat until crisp. Transfer to a large bowl without crushing it.
Heat peanut oil; roast peanuts until crisp and remove. In the same oil fry sliced garlic slowly until golden, then crisp curry leaves.
Turn heat low and stir chilli powder, turmeric, sugar and salt into the fragrant oil for only a moment.
Pour spiced oil over puffed rice, add peanuts and toss with two spoons until all grains are evenly reddish and glossy.
Cool completely to regain crunch and store airtight; serve as a dry Kolhapuri snack.
tips: Add chilli on low heat so it colours the rice without scorching and tasting bitter.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Turn heat low and stir chilli powder, tu: आँच धीमी करके महकते तेल में मिर्च पाउडर, हल्दी, चीनी और नमक बस पलभर मिलाएँ।
hi.Pour spiced oil over puffed rice, add pe: मसालेदार तेल मुरमुरों पर डालें, मूँगफली मिलाएँ और दो चम्मच से चलाएँ ताकि सारे दाने बराबर लाल और चमकदार हों।
hi.Cool completely to regain crunch and sto: पूरा ठंडा करके फिर कुरकुरा होने दें और बंद डिब्बे में रखें; सूखे कोल्हापुरी नाश्ते की तरह परोसें।
hi.Add chilli on low heat so it colours the: मिर्च धीमी आँच पर डालें ताकि मुरमुरों में रंग आए पर जलकर कड़वी न हो।

gu.Heat peanut oil; roast peanuts until cri: મગફળીનું તેલ ગરમ કરી દાણા કરકરા શેકી કાઢો. એ જ તેલમાં લસણની ફાંકો ધીમે સોનેરી કરો, પછી મીઠા લીમડાનાં પાન કરકરા કરો.

gu.Add chilli on low heat so it colours the: મરચું ધીમા તાપે નાખો જેથી મમરાને રંગ આવે પણ બળીને કડવું ન થાય.

recipe.name: Chanachur
steps: Break long sev into short strands. Check that the fried dal and boondi are fully dry and crisp before combining.
Heat mustard oil in a broad pan. Fry peanuts over medium-low heat until brown, then lift out; crisp curry leaves and whole dried chillies in the same oil.
Turn heat off. Add sev, both fried dals, boondi and peanuts, tossing gently so fragile strands do not crumble.
Sprinkle chilli powder, roasted cumin and black salt; toss repeatedly for an even spicy-tangy coating.
Let the mixture cool fully, then store airtight or serve a small bowl with tea or puffed rice.
tips: Store-bought plain sev, dal and boondi are measured components here; use fresh unsalted ones so the final seasoning remains balanced.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Congress Kadlekai
steps: Warm the split peanuts in a dry pan on low heat until crisp, then spread them on a tray to cool.
Heat the oil; fry the curry leaves until crisp. Lift them out, drain, and crumble half.
Turn off the heat and stir chili powder, turmeric and asafoetida into the warm oil for a few seconds without burning them.
Toss the peanuts with the seasoned oil, curry leaves and both salts until every piece is lightly coated.
Sprinkle lemon juice over the warm peanuts, toss once more and cool completely before storing airtight.
tips: Bengaluru bakery-style Congress kadlekai uses split, skinless peanuts; add lemon sparingly to preserve its crunch.

recipe.name: Jackfruit Chips
steps: Oil the knife and hands lightly; remove the jackfruit core and seeds, then cut the firm raw flesh into thin even strips.
Pat the strips very dry. Mix salt, turmeric and chili powder in a dry bowl for seasoning after frying.
Heat coconut oil in a deep pan. Fry jackfruit in small batches at medium heat, stirring so the strips separate.
Continue frying until the bubbling nearly stops and the jackfruit strips are fully cooked and crisp; lift out and drain on a rack.
Fry curry leaves briefly, toss them with the warm chips and dry seasoning, then cool fully before serving or storing airtight.
tips: Use firm unripe jackfruit; ripe sweet pods soften instead of becoming crisp.

recipe.name: Potato Wafers
steps: Slice the peeled potatoes paper-thin with a mandoline and rinse until the water runs mostly clear.
Dry the slices thoroughly between clean towels. Mix salt, pepper, turmeric and chili powder in a dry bowl.
Heat the oil moderately hot; slide in a small batch of slices individually and stir gently to prevent sticking.
Fry until the sizzling slows and the wafers are pale golden and crisp; lift out and drain on a rack.
Toss the warm wafers with the dry spice mixture, cool completely and store airtight.
tips: Even thickness and thoroughly dried slices keep homemade bataka wafers crisp.

gu.Heat the oil moderately hot; slide in a: તેલ મધ્યમ ગરમ કરો; બટાકાની નાની ખેપની સ્લાઇસ એકેક કરી નાખો અને ચોંટે નહીં તે માટે ધીમે હલાવો.
gu.Fry until the sizzling slows and the waf: છાંટા ઓછા થાય અને વેફર આછા સોનેરી કરકરા થાય ત્યાં સુધી તળો; કાઢી જાળી પર નિતારો.
gu.Toss the warm wafers with the dry spice: ગરમ વેફરમાં સૂકો મસાલો ભેળવો, સંપૂર્ણ ઠંડા કરી હવાબંધ ડબ્બામાં ભરો.
gu.Even thickness and thoroughly dried slic: સરખી જાડાઈ અને બરાબર સૂકેલી સ્લાઇસ ઘરે બનાવેલા બટાકા વેફર કરકરા રાખે છે.

recipe.name: Tapioca Chips
steps: Peel the cassava thickly to remove the pinkish inner skin; split and pull out the fibrous center, then slice very thinly.
Rinse the slices in fresh water and pat fully dry; mix salt, chili powder and turmeric in a small bowl.
Heat coconut oil over medium heat and fry the cassava in small batches, separating slices with a slotted spoon.
Fry until bubbling nearly stops and the chips are firm and lightly golden; drain well on a rack.
Briefly fry the curry leaves, toss them with the hot chips and spice mix, then cool before storing.
tips: Cassava needs thorough peeling and full cooking; do not eat it raw.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।
hi.Peel the cassava thickly to remove the p: कसावा का गुलाबी भीतरी छिलका भी मोटा छीलें; बीच का रेशेदार भाग निकालें और बहुत पतली फाँकें काटें।
hi.Rinse the slices in fresh water and pat: फाँकें ताज़े पानी से धोकर पूरी तरह सुखाएँ; नमक, मिर्च पाउडर और हल्दी मिलाएँ।
hi.Heat coconut oil over medium heat and fr: नारियल तेल मध्यम आँच पर गरम करें और कसावा थोड़ी-थोड़ी मात्रा में तलें; झारे से फाँकें अलग रखें।
hi.Fry until bubbling nearly stops and the: बुलबुले लगभग थमने और चिप्स सख़्त तथा हल्के सुनहरे होने तक तलें; जाली पर तेल निथारें।
hi.Briefly fry the curry leaves, toss them: करी पत्ते झटपट तलें, गरम चिप्स और मसाला मिलाएँ, फिर ठंडे करके रखें।
hi.Cassava needs thorough peeling and full: कसावा अच्छी तरह छीलना और पूरा पकाना ज़रूरी है; इसे कच्चा न खाएँ।

gu.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: માત્રા ચાર પુખ્ત વ્યક્તિઓ માટે છે. દરેક પગલામાં પાકવાના સંકેત તપાસો અને સ્વાદ પ્રમાણે મસાલો ગોઠવો. જૈન યોગ્યતા તમારા પરિવારના સામગ્રીના નિયમો પર આધારિત છે.
gu.Peel the cassava thickly to remove the p: કસાવાની ગુલાબી અંદરની છાલ પણ જાડી રીતે છોલો; વચ્ચેનો રેસાદાર ભાગ કાઢી ખૂબ પાતળી સ્લાઇસ કરો.
gu.Rinse the slices in fresh water and pat: સ્લાઇસ તાજા પાણીથી ધોઈ સંપૂર્ણ સૂકવો; મીઠું, મરચું પાઉડર અને હળદર ભેળવો.
gu.Heat coconut oil over medium heat and fr: નાળિયેરનું તેલ મધ્યમ તાપે ગરમ કરી કસાવા નાની ખેપમાં તળો; ઝારાથી સ્લાઇસ અલગ રાખો.
gu.Fry until bubbling nearly stops and the: પરપોટા લગભગ બંધ થાય અને ચિપ્સ કડક તથા આછા સોનેરી થાય ત્યાં સુધી તળો; જાળી પર તેલ નિતારો.
gu.Briefly fry the curry leaves, toss them: મીઠા લીમડાનાં પાન ઝડપથી તળો, ગરમ ચિપ્સ અને મસાલો ભેળવો, પછી ઠંડા કરી ભરો.
gu.Cassava needs thorough peeling and full: કસાવા સારી રીતે છોલવો અને પૂરેપૂરો રાંધવો જરૂરી છે; કાચો ન ખાવો.

recipe.name: Moong Dal Namkeen
steps: Rinse the moong dal until clear, soak in the measured water until swollen but still firm, then drain thoroughly.
Spread the dal on towels to remove surface moisture; clumps of wet dal will sputter in oil.
Heat oil to medium hot. Lower a small portion of dal in a frying sieve and stir until bubbling subsides and grains turn crisp.
Lift out the sieve, drain the dal well and repeat with remaining portions; do not brown the grains deeply.
While warm, toss with salt, chaat masala and chili powder; cool fully to retain the signature dry crunch.
tips: A frying sieve keeps individual lentils together and makes it easy to remove them before they brown.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।
hi.Rinse the moong dal until clear, soak in: मूंग दाल पानी साफ़ आने तक धोएँ, दिए पानी में फूलने पर भी सख़्त रहने तक भिगोएँ, फिर पूरी तरह निथारें।
hi.Spread the dal on towels to remove surfa: दाल कपड़ों पर फैलाकर सतह का पानी सुखाएँ; गीली दाल तेल में तेज़ छींटे मारती है।
hi.Heat oil to medium hot. Lower a small po: तेल मध्यम गरम करें। थोड़ी दाल तलने की जाली में डालकर बुलबुले कम होने और दाने कुरकुरे होने तक चलाएँ।
hi.Lift out the sieve, drain the dal well a: जाली निकालकर दाल का तेल अच्छी तरह निथारें और बची दाल इसी तरह तलें; दाने गहरे भूरे न हों।
hi.While warm, toss with salt, chaat masala: हल्की गरम दाल में नमक, चाट मसाला और मिर्च मिलाएँ; खास सूखा कुरकुरापन बनाए रखने को पूरी ठंडी करें।
hi.A frying sieve keeps individual lentils: तलने की जाली दानों को साथ रखती है और भूरे होने से पहले निकालना आसान बनाती है।

gu.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: માત્રા ચાર પુખ્ત વ્યક્તિઓ માટે છે. દરેક પગલામાં પાકવાના સંકેત તપાસો અને સ્વાદ પ્રમાણે મસાલો ગોઠવો. જૈન યોગ્યતા તમારા પરિવારના સામગ્રીના નિયમો પર આધારિત છે.

gu.Spread the dal on towels to remove surfa: દાળ કપડાં પર ફેલાવી ઉપરનું પાણી સૂકવો; ભીની દાળ તેલમાં વધારે છાંટા મારે છે.
gu.Heat oil to medium hot. Lower a small po: તેલ મધ્યમ ગરમ કરો. થોડી દાળ તળવાની જાળીમાં નાખી પરપોટા ઓછા થાય અને દાણા કરકરા થાય ત્યાં સુધી હલાવો.
gu.Lift out the sieve, drain the dal well a: જાળી કાઢી દાળનું તેલ સારી રીતે નિતારો અને બાકી દાળ આ રીતે તળો; દાણા ઘેરા ભૂરા ન થાય.
gu.While warm, toss with salt, chaat masala: હળવી ગરમ દાળમાં મીઠું, ચાટ મસાલો અને મરચું ભેળવો; ખાસ સૂકું કરકરાપણું રહે તે માટે પૂરી ઠંડી કરો.
gu.A frying sieve keeps individual lentils: તળવાની જાળી દાણાને સાથે રાખે છે અને ભૂરા થાય તે પહેલાં કાઢવામાં મદદ કરે છે.

recipe.name: Khatta Meetha Mixture
steps: Check that the sev and boondi are dry and crisp; if soft, warm them gently in a dry pan and cool.
Warm oil in a small pan and fry peanuts over medium heat until golden and crunchy; drain well.
Crisp the curry leaves in the same oil, then fry raisins only until they plump; remove promptly.
Mix powdered sugar, chaat masala, chili powder and salt. Combine sev, boondi, peanuts, raisins and curry leaves in a wide bowl.
Toss the seasoning through while the fried items are still slightly warm, cool completely and keep airtight.
tips: Add the sweet seasoning only after frying; sugar in hot oil burns and turns bitter.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Add the sweet seasoning only after fryin: मीठा मसाला तलने के बाद ही मिलाएँ; गरम तेल में चीनी जलकर कड़वी हो जाती है।

gu.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: માત્રા ચાર પુખ્ત વ્યક્તિઓ માટે છે. દરેક પગલામાં પાકવાના સંકેત તપાસો અને સ્વાદ પ્રમાણે મસાલો ગોઠવો. જૈન યોગ્યતા તમારા પરિવારના સામગ્રીના નિયમો પર આધારિત છે.

gu.Crisp the curry leaves in the same oil,: એ જ તેલમાં મીઠા લીમડાનાં પાન કરકરાં કરો, પછી કિસમિસ ફૂલે ત્યાં સુધી જ તળી તરત કાઢો.
gu.Mix powdered sugar, chaat masala, chili: દળેલી ખાંડ, ચાટ મસાલો, મરચું અને મીઠું ભેળવો. પહોળા વાસણમાં સેવ, બુંદી, મગફળી, કિસમિસ અને મીઠા લીમડાનાં પાન ભેળવો.
gu.Toss the seasoning through while the fri: તળેલી સામગ્રી હળવી ગરમ હોય ત્યારે મસાલો સારી રીતે ભેળવો, પૂરી ઠંડી કરી હવાબંધ ડબ્બામાં ભરો.
gu.Add the sweet seasoning only after fryin: મીઠો મસાલો તળ્યા પછી જ નાખો; ગરમ તેલમાં ખાંડ બળી કડવી થાય છે.

recipe.name: Gobi Manchurian
steps: Blanch cauliflower briefly in boiling water, drain thoroughly and pat dry so the coating sticks.
Whisk gram flour, most cornflour, salt and enough measured water into a thick coating batter; reserve a little cornflour and water for the sauce.
Coat the dry florets and fry in batches at medium-high heat until deeply crisp; drain on a rack rather than paper.
In a hot wok, briefly sauté minced garlic, ginger and chilies; add soy sauce, ketchup, vinegar and the reserved slurry, and simmer until glossy.
Toss the cauliflower quickly in the thick sauce, scatter spring onion greens and serve immediately before it softens.
tips: This is the dry snack version: coat with just enough sauce to glaze, not drown, the cauliflower.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।
hi.Blanch cauliflower briefly in boiling wa: फूलगोभी को उबलते पानी में थोड़ी देर डालें, पूरी निथारें और पोंछें ताकि घोल चिपके।
hi.Whisk gram flour, most cornflour, salt a: बेसन, अधिकतर कॉर्नफ्लोर, नमक और दिए पानी से गाढ़ा लेप वाला घोल बनाएँ; थोड़े कॉर्नफ्लोर और पानी सॉस के लिए रखें।
hi.Coat the dry florets and fry in batches: सूखे फूलों पर घोल लगाकर मध्यम-तेज़ आँच पर थोड़ी-थोड़ी मात्रा में अच्छी तरह कुरकुरा तलें; कागज़ की जगह जाली पर निकालें।
hi.In a hot wok, briefly sauté minced garli: गरम कड़ाही में कटा लहसुन, अदरक और मिर्च थोड़ी देर भूनें; सोया सॉस, केचप, सिरका और बचा घोल मिलाकर चमकदार होने तक पकाएँ।

recipe.name: Beetroot Cutlet
steps: Grate the beetroot, squeeze out excess juice and cook it in a dry pan until its raw smell fades; cool.
Mash the potatoes and mix with beetroot, minced chili, coriander, ginger, chaat masala, salt and half the crumbs.
Shape equal oval cutlets with firm hands; coat each in the remaining crumbs and chill until set.
Heat a thin film of oil in a skillet and shallow-fry cutlets over medium heat until one side is golden; turn once carefully.
Brown the second side, drain briefly and serve hot with coriander chutney while the crust is crisp.
tips: Drying the beetroot first prevents the patties from turning soft and leaking color into the oil.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Oats Tikki
steps: Dry-toast the oats until lightly fragrant; pulse only half to coarse crumbs so the finished tikki still shows flakes.
Cook peas until tender, drain dry and lightly crush; mash the potatoes separately.
Combine oats, potato, peas, chopped onion, coriander, chili, ginger, cumin and salt; rest until oats absorb moisture.
Shape compact patties; if the mixture feels sticky, let it stand longer instead of adding extra flour.
Pan-fry in a thin layer of oil over medium heat until both sides are crisp and brown; serve with mint chutney.
tips: Keeping some oats whole gives texture; finely grinding all of them makes a dense, pasty patty.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Corn Tikki
steps: Cook the sweet corn just until tender and drain completely; roughly crush one-third of the kernels.
Mash potatoes and mix with whole and crushed corn, half the crumbs, coriander, chili, ginger, cumin, chaat masala and salt.
Shape firm round tikkis, pressing in loose kernels; dust lightly in remaining bread crumbs.
Heat oil in a wide skillet and shallow-fry the tikkis over medium heat without crowding or moving them early.
Turn after the first side forms a crust, brown the other side and serve hot with green chutney.
tips: The mixture should have visible corn kernels; do not puree the corn into a smooth paste.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Papeta Pattice
steps: Boil potatoes in their skins until just tender, peel and mash smoothly while warm; cool to a firm dough with salt.
Mix coconut, cashews, raisins, sugar, minced chili, coriander and lemon juice into a moist sweet-tangy filling.
Flatten a portion of potato in your palm, enclose a spoon of filling and seal all seams; repeat with remaining mixture.
Shape thick oval pattice, roll lightly in bread crumbs and chill until firm so the filling stays inside.
Shallow-fry in medium-hot oil, turning carefully, until both sides develop a golden crust; serve hot.
tips: Parsi papeta pattice contrasts a gently sweet coconut-nut center with a savory potato shell.

recipe.name: Cabbage Pakoda
steps: Slice cabbage and onion very thinly; pat dry so their moisture does not thin the batter.
Toss vegetables with gram flour, rice flour, minced chili, torn curry leaves, chili powder and salt.
Add measured water little by little only until flour clings to the shreds; leave the cabbage visible rather than making a runny batter.
Drop loose small handfuls into medium-hot oil and fry without crowding, turning until rough edges become golden and crisp.
Drain on a wire rack, not stacked paper, and serve immediately with coconut or coriander chutney.
tips: A loose, barely moistened coating gives cabbage pakoda its lacy crispy edges.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Rava Vada
steps: Mix semolina with yogurt and measured water to a thick spoonable dough; cover and rest until the grains swell.
Fold in finely chopped onion, chili, ginger, curry leaves, coriander and salt; the mixture should hold a small mound.
Just before frying, sprinkle in baking soda and mix gently; avoid beating out the aeration.
Drop small portions into medium-hot oil and fry in batches, turning so the vadas brown evenly and cook through.
Drain until the surface is dry and crisp; serve warm with coconut chutney.
tips: Unlike soaked-dal medu vada, this quick rava vada gets body from hydrated semolina and yogurt.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Keerai Vadai
steps: Rinse and soak chana dal in the measured water until swollen; drain very well and reserve a small handful whole.
Pulse the remaining dal with chili, ginger and fennel into a coarse crumbly paste, adding no more water.
Mix in dry chopped spinach, onion, curry leaves, reserved dal and salt; squeeze lightly to bind.
Flatten small portions into thin discs and fry in medium-hot oil, turning once the underside has set.
Cook until deep golden, crisp at the rim and no longer damp in the center; drain and serve hot.
tips: Dry the spinach well after washing; excess water makes the lentil vadai heavy and oily.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
